name: Batidão Baile Funk
description: Get ready to dance to infectious Baile Funk rhythms with DJs Pyrats and Kebraku on the iconic Maus Hábitos rooftop.
longDescription:
Batidão Baile Funk presents an evening dedicated to the energetic sounds of Baile Funk, featuring DJ sets from Pyrats and Kebraku. This event focuses on the distinctive rhythms and basslines characteristic of the genre, offering a specific musical focus within Porto's nightlife scene. The selection of DJs aims to deliver a consistent sound experience for enthusiasts of Baile Funk.

Attendees can expect an atmosphere conducive to dancing, set on the rooftop of Maus Hábitos. The venue is known for its elevated outdoor space, providing a specific backdrop for the music. The event is designed for an adult audience interested in electronic music and dance culture. The duration of the event will span several hours, typical of a club night.

This is a ticketed event. Maus Hábitos is located near the São Bento train station, accessible via the São Bento metro station (line D) or various bus routes. It is within walking distance of central Porto. Specific accessibility information for the rooftop area is not provided.
